## Terms

### Atlas Query Shape Insights

- **Atlas Query Shape Insights** · self — Atlas Query Shape Insights aggregates structurally similar queries and ranks shapes by total execution time; it complements Query Profiler, which exposes individual slow operations. Use the shape view to prioritize workload patterns, then investigate individual operations. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/query-shape-insights.md
